text:
maria-cs: Customer (Acme Analytics) reporting sudden 429s from their dedicated pool (dedicated-eu-1). Started ~10:50 UTC, affects all endpoints, chat + embeddings. high priority, they say it started after a plan change.

support_jesse: looking into it. can you paste one of the 429 response bodies? also tenant id?

maria-cs: tenant_id=acme-04, example response:
```json
{ "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "details": "per-tenant quota exceeded: tenant_quota_units=0/1000" }
```

support_jesse: whoa `tenant_quota_units=0` — that looks like the quota hit counter is zeroed or we're reading the wrong quota key. checking rate service now.

sre-oncall: pulled logs from dedicated-eu-1 around 2025-11-04T10:50: got many 429s with code `TENANT_RATE_LIMIT` and log lines: `quota_lookup: key=org:acme-04, bucket=per_min, value=0, limit=1000`. Also autoscaler did not spin because pool utilization < threshold. no recent node failures.

eng-runtime-lin: FYI we had a config deploy yesterday that changed quota key naming for per-tenant bounds (org: -> tenant:). possible mismatch mapping old quotas. investigating mapping code in quota-service.

support_jesse: quick repro curl from inside dedicated pool showed same 429:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACME_KEY" \
  https://dedicated-eu-1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# -> 429 rate_limit_exceeded
```

sre-oncall: ops-bot shows quota-service metrics: "quota_lookups_total" spiked, "quota_miss_rate" ~22% for 10m window. Miss leads to zero default in our legacy fallback logic — which then immediately blocks.

ops-bot: @sre-oncall, created incident INC-20251104-62, severity=high, assigned to eng-runtime.

eng-runtime-lin: confirmed: deploy renamed key to `tenant:acme-04` but existing stored quotas are under `org:acme-04`. Our fallback path returns 0 when lookup misses. That explains the sudden 0/1000 behavior.

billing-anna: Acme just had plan change at 10:45 UTC via billing API (plan->enterprise). If we re-map keys they'll retain their quota. we should avoid touching usage counters until fix.

support_jesse: short-term mitigation: create alias in quota DB (copy org:acme-04 -> tenant:acme-04) or change fallback to treat miss as unlimited for 5m. which is safer?

eng-runtime-lin: prefer alias copy for exact semantics. I'll run a small migration for active tenants. Doing dry-run script now.

sre-oncall: to reduce customer impact, applying emergency override (allowlist) for acme-04 on dedicated-eu-1 for 15 minutes.

support_jesse: applied override via admin UI. Acme confirms latency + 429s dropped off immediately :thumbsup:

maria-cs: they're back online, grateful. please follow up with root cause and timeline for rollback.

eng-runtime-lin: root cause: recent quota-service config change changed key namespace without migrating existing entries. action items:
- run alias migration for tenants created before deploy (in progress)
- add telemetry alert for quota_miss_rate > 1%
- fix fallback behavior to not return 0-blocking value
- add post-deploy smoke to detect key namespace mismatches

sre-oncall: I'll schedule a 2hr runbook to verify migration and remove emergency override after 30m of healthy traffic.

billing-anna: verifying billing record for plan change — no unexpected token charges. will confirm later.

support_jesse: once migration done, will confirm with Acme and close INC-20251104-62. thanks all.

maria-cs: please ping me when incident closed and summary available.

eng-runtime-lin: will send postmortem with timeline + patch PR link.

ops-bot: incident INC-20251104-62 updated: status=investigating -> mitigated, override_applied=true, assignee=eng-runtime-lin.

sre-oncall: follow-up tasks created in backlog: QUOTA-193 (migration), QUOTA-194 (fallback fix), QUOTA-195 (smoke tests).
